acceptanceResults: 无显式 CARGO_TARGET_DIR 时，Cargo 验证默认 target 由当前规范化 checkout 路径稳定派生；两个 linked worktree 不共享构建产物，显式 caller target 仍优先，不能引用已归档 worktree 路径。回归覆盖测试二进制 CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR 路径绑定。
无显式 timeout 的 cargo test --package 节点使用有限 600 秒默认，其他命令继续 300 秒；显式 timeout 仍须通过现有 Contract/项目政策上限且不超过 900 秒。执行、计划、失败与超时收据如实记录，不能跳过或复用未通过测试。
先补准确 RED 负例，再做最小 GREEN；格式、Clippy、完整 cargo test --locked --workspace、针对性执行器回归、当前候选 Runtime 的正式验证以及 PR 精确头 CI 均真实通过，保持 13 个 workspace package 完整覆盖。
保留 WI-1065 的两次失败 attempt；本修复合并并更新本地 Runtime 后，在 WI-1065 原 Contract 与专属工作区重新取得正式验证、PR CI 与后续收尾证据，不把本 WI 的绿灯冒充认知评估交付。

CLI plan-only regression must display the same finite 600-second implicit package-test deadline as the Runtime planner while non-package requests retain 300 seconds; MCP public schema and English/Japanese/Chinese command and capability references must describe these actual defaults without implying that an explicit override bypasses policy.

MCP plan-only, persisted formal attempt command metadata and CLI aggregate receipt must report deadlines consistent with planned and executed package/non-package nodes: implicit cargo test --package is 600 seconds, other implicit commands 300 seconds, and a mixed receipt must not present a smaller timeout as its overall execution bound. Focused negative-to-positive regression and a fresh source-bound formal verification are required; old attempts remain immutable.

Rust material inspection must remain fail-closed while correctly classifying legitimate scoped changes that currently return Unknown: perform a bounded whole-file lexical boundary pass but apply the existing 16,384-token semantic budget to changed-origin and cross-line lexical context, without increasing that semantic limit; incomplete provenance/context or truly over-budget changed context remains Unknown. Parse only supported bounded json! object/array syntax and inspect keys and each value independently; do not join unrelated sibling values. Follow supported static concat!, simple format!, literal bindings and pure-literal function references within one value; a directly inspectable malicious literal/static malicious combination remains Finding, while unresolved candidate macros, dynamic command composition, or unsupported syntax remains Unknown. Treat .join() as path composition only when receiver is proven Path/PathBuf by explicit type, a supported constructor, or bounded local binding; unknown receiver types, string joins, push_str, and possible malicious dynamic composition remain Unknown. Add RED-to-GREEN regressions showing benign json! action data and proven Path::join with unrelated risky-word literals are Clean; direct and static JSON-value injection are Findings; candidate dynamic JSON values, unknown-receiver join and string composition are Unknown. Preserve existing cross-line comment, provenance mismatch, oversized changed-context, marker/operation, and all current fixture-boundary regressions. Do not weaken the gate or simply increase its prior whole-file token threshold.
